channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Tashkent Opens First Center for Contemporary Art in Uzbekistan
item.description: Tashkent will launch "CCA Tashkent" on September 6, the first permanent institution dedicated to contemporary art in Uzbekistan. Housed in a restored 1912 power station, the center will feature exhibition, educational, and research functions, aiming to connect local artists with the international art community.

item.title: Uzbek Craftsmanship Showcased at Venice Exhibition
item.description: Uzbekistan is presenting its craft heritage at the "Homo Faber-2026: An Island of Light" exhibition in Venice, opening September 1. The display features works by four artisans, including large ceramic "Moonjars" and knives from the Kamolov blacksmith dynasty, demonstrating traditional crafts in a contemporary context.

item.title: Dushanbe Increases Public Transport Fleet by 360 Vehicles
item.description: Dushanbe has increased its public transport fleet by 360 vehicles, a 20% rise, starting September 1. This includes buses, trolleybuses, and minibuses. The move aims to accommodate the increased passenger numbers with the start of the academic year. The city plans to gradually add more electric vehicles.

item.title: Iran Views SCO Summit as Opportunity to Counter US Policy
item.description: Iran's participation in the SCO summit offers strategic opportunities to boost trade and economic ties amid US-induced instability in the Persian Gulf, according to an Iranian lawmaker. The SCO platform is seen as a chance to expand economic partnerships and counter Washington's policies.

item.title: Nearly 30 Documents Signed at Bishkek SCO Summit
item.description: Around 30 documents were signed at the regular meeting of the heads of state of SCO member countries in Bishkek on September 1st. The Bishkek Declaration, commemorating the SCO's 25th anniversary, and documents aimed at strengthening multilateral cooperation were adopted.

item.title: SCO is World's Largest Regional Organization, Says Putin
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) is effectively the world's largest regional organization. Member states represent nearly half the global population and over a third of global GDP, possessing significant intellectual, technological, and natural resources.

item.title: Omurbek Babanov announces withdrawal from presidential race, ending political career
item.description: Former Prime Minister Omurbek Babanov has declared he will not run for president and has concluded his political career. The announcement marks a significant shift in the country's political landscape.

item.title: Trump labels Iran a 'state in crisis,' claims leadership is incapable
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has officially declared Iran a 'state in crisis,' asserting that its leadership is incapable of governing and has lost its military strength. He alleged that the government is not paying its military and police forces.

item.title: Putin highlights SCO as largest regional association, emphasizing trade and potential
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the SCO is the largest regional association globally, encompassing nearly half the world's population and over a third of global GDP. He noted the bloc's significant intellectual, technological, and natural resource potential, emphasizing increased trade among member states as a key objective.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of Key Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek concluded with the adoption of several important documents, including amendments to the SCO Charter and regulations for a Universal Center. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced the establishment of a Center for Combating International Organized Crime in Bishkek.

item.title: Belarus President Advocates Unified Digital Space for SCO Members
item.description: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko called for the swift creation of a unified, open, and secure digital space within the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO). Speaking at the SCO Summit in Bishkek, he also supported establishing an SCO Development Bank to enhance economic ties and financial sovereignty, and increasing the use of national currencies in mutual settlements.

item.title: OIC Foreign Ministers Elect New Secretary-General, Discuss Palestine in Jeddah
item.description: Foreign ministers of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) met in Jeddah to elect Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed of Mauritania as the new Secretary-General and discuss the situation in Palestine. Tajikistan's Ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Akram Karimi, attended and spoke, highlighting Tajikistan's initiative for a decade of peace.

item.title: Tajik citizens in Russia can register residency via Amina app from September 1
item.description: Starting September 1, 2026, foreign citizens in Russia, including those from Tajikistan, must use the Amina mobile application for residency registration. Previously used in Moscow and the Moscow region, the app's scope has expanded to cover all foreign nationals entering Russia visa-free. The app allows individuals over 18 to register their place of residence.

item.title: Emomali Rahmon's speech at the 79th UN General Assembly session
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon addressed the 79th session of the UN General Assembly. His speech touched upon topics including the "cold war," artificial intelligence, "two-faced policy," and the situations in Palestine and Afghanistan.

item.title: Winning projects announced in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative
item.description: Over 2,195 projects have been selected as winners in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative, following the conclusion of the voting process. More than 10 million votes were cast nationwide. Details are available via the provided link.

item.title: Tajik Prime Minister Meets with OPEC Fund President to Discuss Cooperation
item.description: Tajikistan's Prime Minister Kohir Rasulzada met with the President of the OPEC Fund for International Development, Abdulhamid Alkhalifa, on August 31. They expressed satisfaction with bilateral relations and cooperation, anticipating further expansion. The signing of a Country Partnership Strategy for 2026-2028 was discussed.

item.title: Indian PM Modi Urges Putin to End Ukraine War and Seek Peaceful Resolution
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to end the war in Ukraine and resolve issues peacefully, according to excerpts from their August 31 conversation. Modi emphasized that continuing the war pushes humanity backward, while peace efforts offer hope.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Economy Grows 8.5% in First Half of 2026, Driven by Demand and Investment
item.description: Uzbekistan's economy expanded by 8.5% in the first half of 2026, accelerating from 7.7% in 2025. Growth is supported by consumer demand, investment, and services, with retail sales up 20.2% and capital investments increasing by 17.5%. Foreign direct investment reached $39.6 billion, with significant contributions from China and the Persian Gulf.

item.title: New Electric Train to Reduce Travel Time Between Tashkent and Andijan
item.description: A new Chinese-made CR200J electric train will soon operate between Tashkent and Andijan, with test runs currently underway. The train covers the distance in 4 hours, significantly reducing the current 6-7 hour journey. It can carry approximately 400 passengers and reach speeds of up to 160 km/h.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek: Leaders Discuss Regional Security, AI, and Future Projects
item.description: Bishkek hosts the 25th anniversary Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit with leaders from all 10 member states attending. Discussions focus on regional security, economic applications of AI, and future projects. The summit aims to adopt the Bishkek Declaration, building on the organization's evolution from a border security pact to a broader regional forum.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon Attends Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon participated in the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek on August 31. The games, held in Kyrgyzstan until September 6, coincide with Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day and the SCO summit. Rahmon held meetings with leaders of several SCO member states and other governments.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan's National Bank sets dollar exchange rate at 87.45 soms
item.description: As of 9:30 AM on September 1, commercial banks in Kyrgyzstan were buying dollars for up to 87.55 soms and selling for 87.80 soms. The National Bank of Kyrgyzstan set the official exchange rate at 87.45 soms per dollar.

item.title: Kazakhstan considers VAT exemption for QR payment services
item.description: Kazakhstan is considering exempting QR payment services from VAT, according to Vice Prime Minister Serik Zhumangarin. The initiative aims to extend the VAT exemption, currently applied to payment card operations, to other cashless payment methods like QR codes and digital tenge. Calculations on economic feasibility are pending.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon meets Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Bishkek
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon met with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Bishkek on August 31. The leaders discussed bilateral cooperation, economic ties, energy, transport, agriculture, tourism, and cultural exchanges. They also exchanged views on the Middle East situation and conflict resolution.

item.title: UN Chief António Guterres meets with leaders of Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan in Bishkek
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres held bilateral meetings in Bishkek with the Presidents of Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan. Discussions covered regional situations, UN cooperation, climate change, socio-economic development, and Kyrgyzstan's upcoming UN Security Council membership. Guterres praised Uzbekistan's peace initiatives and Tajikistan's support for water resource agendas.

item.title: Tajikistan's Minister of Industry discusses industrial development and economic reforms with IMF representative
item.description: Tajikistan's Minister of Industry, Sherali Kabir, met with the IMF Resident Representative, Gazi Shbaikat, in Dushanbe. They discussed the national economy, industrial development prospects, and future cooperation. The Minister highlighted the positive economic dynamics and the ongoing second phase of the National Industrialization Strategy, focusing on modernization and export potential.

item.title: Russia and Kyrgyzstan enhance cooperation in infectious disease research
item.description: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor and Kyrgyz epidemiologists are advancing their collaboration in infectious disease research, moving to a new stage of technological interaction. Joint projects will be implemented at the Kyrgyz-Russian Scientific Center for Infectious Disease Research. Russia has previously supplied hepatitis B vaccines to Kyrgyzstan, leading to a threefold decrease in incidence rates.

item.title: UN establishes International Day for Safe and Trustworthy AI at Tajikistan's initiative
item.description: The UN General Assembly, at Tajikistan's initiative, has established August 31 as the International Day for Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence, starting in 2027. This decision follows Tajikistan's consistent efforts to promote international AI agendas and responsible technology use. The date marks the anniversary of the 1955 Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon meets with UN Secretary-General Guterres and Armenian PM Pashinyan
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon held meetings with UN Secretary-General António Guterres and Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan in Bishkek on August 31. Rahmon thanked Guterres for UN support of Tajikistan's initiatives, including the 'Decade of Peace for Future Generations.' Guterres acknowledged Tajikistan's leading role in global issues like water resources and glaciers.

item.title: Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games Held Without Incident in Bishkek
item.description: The opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games took place in Bishkek on August 31 without public order disturbances or incidents, according to the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Kyrgyzstan. Police are maintaining enhanced security measures for participants and residents during the games.

item.title: Putin and Tokayev Discuss Cooperation and Kazakhstan's Reforms at SCO Summit
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev held talks on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek. They noted dynamic cooperation and discussed Kazakhstan's constitutional reforms and economic development. Putin congratulated Tokayev on successful Kurultai elections.

item.title: Uzbek President Mirziyoyev arrives in Bishkek for SCO summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev arrived in Bishkek on August 31 for the SCO summit and a "SCO plus" meeting. He was met at Manas International Airport by Kyrgyz officials. During the summit, Mirziyoyev held talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, discussing bilateral relations and upcoming diplomatic anniversary events.

item.title: Uzbek President Attends Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev participated in the opening ceremony of the sixth World Nomad Games in Bishkek. Over 3,000 athletes from more than 90 countries are competing. Uzbekistan has 141 representatives participating in 30 sports, including kurash, sambo, and equestrian events.

item.title: Foreign Leaders Congratulate Uzbekistan on Independence Day
item.description: Foreign leaders are sending congratulatory messages to Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on the country's 35th Independence Day. Messages highlight Uzbekistan's reforms, socio-economic development, and its role in Central Asian peace and regional cooperation. Partnerships in trade, investment, and culture are noted.

item.title: Uzbek and Russian Presidents Meet in Bishkek to Discuss Strategic Partnership
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Bishkek. The leaders discussed further developing strategic partnership and allied relations between Uzbekistan and Russia. The meeting took place during the World Nomad Games.

item.title: Uzbek President Meets US Special Envoy Sergio Gor in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with US Special Envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor in Bishkek. They discussed strengthening Uzbek-American strategic partnership, political dialogue, and economic cooperation. Priorities include energy, transport, critical minerals, digital technologies, and agriculture.

item.title: Indian companies may invest $3.4 billion in Uzbekistan's energy sector
item.description: Indian companies are considering investing $3.4 billion in Uzbekistan's energy sector. The Energy Minister stated that five major projects have been proposed to investors, including the construction of high-voltage power lines, hydroelectric, and thermal power plants.

item.title: Kazakhstan's Kurultai to focus on AI, migration, and energy policy
item.description: Kazakhstan's Kurultai will address artificial intelligence, migration policy, and energy sustainability. Deputies will review existing laws, develop AI and digital assets, and regulate online platforms. The Kurultai will also discuss the national budget for the next three years.

item.title: Uzbek President Discusses Cooperation With UN Secretary-General
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek. Guterres congratulated Uzbekistan on its 35th independence anniversary. They discussed expanding cooperation with the UN and its institutions, and Guterres welcomed Uzbekistan's achievements in Sustainable Development Goals.

item.title: Kazakhstan's 'Umai' mortgage program for women temporarily suspended due to fund exhaustion
item.description: Kazakhstan's 'Umai' mortgage program, exclusively for women, has suspended new applications after exhausting its current funding tranche. Launched on August 31, the program reached its limit the same day. Otbasy Bank is exploring early disbursement of the next tranche, planned with the Asian Development Bank, to resume applications.
